description: This PHP file defines the Timesheet entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping the Timesheet to a database table with properties such as id, state, start and end dates, and associated employee. It includes ORM annotations and methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: Timesheet
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet with properties for ID, state, start and end dates, and associated employee, mapped to the 'ohrm_timesheet' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the timesheet.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the timesheet.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the timesheet.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of the timesheet.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the timesheet period.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with the timesheet.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with the timesheet.
